title: File Tracking Entity
description: Azure Table Storage entity tracking discovery and processing status of each CSV file. PartitionKey = site_id (string), RowKey = SHA-256 hash of S3 key.

RowKey.description: SHA-256 hash of the full S3 key, truncated to 64 characters

Size.description: File size in bytes from S3 listing

LastModified.description: ISO-8601 last-modified timestamp from S3 listing

EnqueuedAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when the work item was dispatched

CompletedAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when the worker finished processing

RecordsEmitted.description: Number of records successfully emitted from this file

CorrelationId.description: Correlation ID of the dispatcher run that enqueued this file
